title: The Arthur Currie Farm above the Becaguimic
description: The Arthur Currie Farm stood above the Becaguimic River. On this farm, women churned butter, sewed clothing, made soap, and preserved food in crocks and jars. Meanwhile, children carried out chores, which were not optional but essential. As a result, there was pride in taking everything they needed from their land.
